facts.value: HCR 61 proposed a special task force to study interagency consultation for data centers and more complete natural-resource planning and management.
facts.supporting_quote: Creates a special task force to study the interagency consultation process for data centers to ensure more complete natural resource planning and management

facts.value: On May 21, the resolution was read and lay over. On May 22, it was referred to Natural Resources and Environment. It was reported with amendments May 28, amended and recommitted to House and Governmental Affairs May 29, and reported with amendments June 3; both committee reports were 10–0. On June 4, it was amended, ordered reengrossed and passed to third reading; floor debate was scheduled for June 8.
facts.locator: Named history, May 21–June 4; House journal pages 5, 4, 38, 10, 69 and 10
facts.supporting_quote: 06/04 H 10 Read by title, amended, ordered reengrossed, passed to 3rd reading.

facts.value: On June 8, the House suspended the rules, called HCR 61 out of order, read it and returned it to the calendar; it was then amended and returned, called from the calendar, amended again and adopted 93–0. It was ordered to the Senate.
facts.locator: Named history, June 8; House journal pages 18, 23 and 49
facts.supporting_quote: Read by title, amended, roll called on final consideration, yeas 93, nays 0. The resolution was adopted and ordered to the Senate.

facts.value: The Senate received HCR 61 on June 8, suspended the rules, read it a first time and placed it on the calendar for second reading. Its last recorded action was June 9: read by title and returned to the calendar, subject to call. The displayed status is 'Subject to call - Senate referral.'
facts.locator: Named history, June 8 Senate journal page 97 and June 9 Senate journal page 62; current-status heading
facts.supporting_quote: 06/09 S 62 Read by title and returned to the Calendar, subject to call.

facts.value: The Senate adjourned sine die at 5:52 p.m. on June 12, 2025. The journal separately identifies the following material as post-session legislative actions.
facts.locator: June 12 Senate journal, physical page 100, printed page 1338
facts.supporting_quote: On motion of Senator Talbot, at 5:52 o'clock P.M. the Senate adjourned until Sine Die.
